source: DDInter v2.0 subset + manual curation — MVP top-50 outpatient interactions

interactions.description: Warfarin + NSAIDs (ibuprofen): increased bleeding risk. Monitor INR closely; consider alternative analgesic.
Warfarin + Aspirin (>100mg): significantly increased bleeding risk.
SSRIs + Tramadol: serotonin syndrome risk. Avoid combination.
ACE inhibitors + potassium supplements: hyperkalemia risk. Monitor potassium levels.
Metformin + IV contrast media: lactic acidosis risk. Hold metformin 48h around contrast procedures.

coverage_note: MVP ships with ~5 representative interactions. Production must expand to full DDInter dataset. Coverage documented in agent/data/ddi-README.md.
